E0218

`mem.pin` needs a write window made with the write-access marker `&` into the place being pinned.

What

`mem.pin` needs a write window made with the write-access marker `&` into the place being pinned.

Why

A pin promises one storage location will not move, so it has to name that location with the write-access marker; see the sigil reading rule above.

Fix

Write `mem.pin(&place)` with the write-access marker `&`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0218: tests/ui/pin_needs_write_window.stderr.

    |                       ^^^^

 Fix: write `mem.pin(&place)` with the write-access marker `&`
